            item.variantName ||
            item.variant_name ||

            (item.variant && (item.variant.name || item.variant.productName || item.variant.product_name || item.variant.title)) ||
            null
        const normalizedName = rawName === null || rawName === undefined ? '' : String(rawName).trim()
        const sizeSource = item.size && typeof item.size === 'object' ? item.size : null
        const colorSource = item.color && typeof item.color === 'object' ? item.color : null
        const rawImage = item.imageUrl || item.image_url || item.image || null
        const stock = item.stockAvailable || item.stock_available || item.stockQuantity || item.stock_quantity || 0
        const sizeMeta = resolveSizeMeta({
            id: item.sizeId || item.size_id || (sizeSource && sizeSource.id),

function normalizeOrderStatus(value) {
    const key = normalizeStatusKey(value)

    if (['NEW', 'PENDING', 'WAITING', 'CHUA_XU_LY', 'CHO_XU_LY'].includes(key)) return 'PENDING'
    if (['CONFIRMED', 'PROCESSING', 'DANG_XU_LY', 'XAC_NHAN', 'IN_PROGRESS'].includes(key)) return 'PROCESSING'
    if (['SHIPPING', 'DELIVERING', 'DANG_GIAO', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'TRANSIT'].includes(key)) return 'SHIPPING'
    if (['SUCCESS', 'COMPLETED', 'DELIVERED', 'THANH_CONG', 'HOAN_THANH', 'RECEIVED'].includes(key)) return 'SUCCESS'
    if (['RETURNING', 'TRA_HANG', 'YEU_CAU_TRA'].includes(key)) return 'RETURNING'
    if (['RETURNED', 'HOAN_TRA', 'HOAN_TIEN', 'REFUND', 'REFUNDED'].includes(key)) return 'RETURNED'
    if (['CANCELLED', 'CANCELED', 'DA_HUY', 'HUY', 'FAILED'].includes(key)) return 'CANCELLED'

    return key || 'PENDING'
}

function normalizeOrderItem(rawOrder) {
    const source = rawOrder && typeof rawOrder === 'object' ? rawOrder : {}

    const normalizedId = toFiniteNumber(
        source.id !== undefined && source.id !== null ? source.id :
        source.orderId !== undefined && source.orderId !== null ? source.orderId :
        source.order_id,
        null,
    )

    const createdAt =
        source.createdAt ||
        source.created_at ||
        source.orderDate ||
        source.order_date ||
        null

    const finalAmount = Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(
        source.finalAmount !== undefined && source.finalAmount !== null ? source.finalAmount :
        source.final_amount !== undefined && source.final_amount !== null ? source.final_amount :
        source.totalAmount !== undefined && source.totalAmount !== null ? source.totalAmount :
        source.total_amount !== undefined && source.total_amount !== null ? source.total_amount :
        source.totalMoney !== undefined && source.totalMoney !== null ? source.totalMoney :
        source.total_money,
        0,
    ))

    const shippingFee = toFiniteNumber(
        source.shippingFee !== undefined && source.shippingFee !== null ? source.shippingFee :
        source.shipping_fee !== undefined && source.shipping_fee !== null ? source.shipping_fee :
        source.shipping !== undefined && source.shipping !== null ? source.shipping :
        source.shippingAmount !== undefined && source.shippingAmount !== null ? source.shippingAmount :
        source.shipping_amount !== undefined && source.shipping_amount !== null ? source.shipping_amount :
        source.deliveryFee !== undefined && source.deliveryFee !== null ? source.deliveryFee :
        source.delivery_fee !== undefined && source.delivery_fee !== null ? source.delivery_fee :
        source.shipFee !== undefined && source.shipFee !== null ? source.shipFee :
        source.ship_fee !== undefined && source.ship_fee !== null ? source.ship_fee :
        source.feeShip !== undefined && source.feeShip !== null ? source.feeShip :
        source.fee_ship,
        0,
    )

    const discountAmount = Math.max(0, toFiniteNumber(
        source.discountAmount !== undefined && source.discountAmount !== null ? source.discountAmount :
        source.discount_amount,
        0,
    ))

    const paymentStatus =
        source.paymentStatus ||
        source.payment_status ||
        source.paymentMethod ||
        source.payment_method ||
        'PENDING'

    const status =
        source.status ||
        source.orderStatus ||
        source.order_status ||
        'PENDING'

    return {
        ...source,
        id: normalizedId,
        createdAt,
        finalAmount,
        shippingFee,
        discountAmount,
        paymentStatus: normalizePaymentStatus(paymentStatus),
        status: normalizeOrderStatus(status),
    }
}

function toCodePart(value, fallback) {
    const text = normalizeText(value)
    if (!text) return fallback

    const normalized = text
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .replace(/đ/g, 'd')
        .replace(/Đ/g, 'D')
        .toUpperCase()
        .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '-')
        .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')

    return normalized || fallback
}
